events.title: Update 0.1.24: blood moon title screen, smoother demo, team room for eight
events.summary: Howdy! Version 0.1.24 is out, in the free demo as well. It opens with a brand-new title screen, makes the first minutes of the demo a lot smoother, seats eight people in pairs in the saloon, and ends with a long pass through every game mode that twenty-one bugs did not come back from. A new title screen The saloon wall is gone. events.title: Update 0.1.23: a cleaner table and a shop that explains itself
events.summary: Howdy! Version 0.1.23 is out, and the free demo has it too. Most of this update is about the table itself: what you read while you play, what stands in your way, and what the smuggler actually sells you. One callout at a time "Your turn", your score, "Took the lead!" and the opponent's house rule used to fire at the same moment and land right on top of each other. events.title: v0.1.20: The Lanterns Are Lit and the Outlaws Have Bodies
events.summary: Light, because the game had exactly one of everything I measured it before touching anything: on four of the five main screens more than 80 percent of the image sat close to black, and up to 99 percent of all colored pixels sat in the same brown and gold wedge. One hue, one brightness. The lanterns painted into the backgrounds did not actually light anything. Now they do.
